code.description: Python source to execute in the conversation's persistent kernel. Multi-line is fine. IPython magics (%timeit, %who, ?help) are supported. Writes to /work/outputs/ auto-publish as conversation artifacts.

timeout_ms.description: Hard wall-clock ceiling in milliseconds. On expiry the kernel receives a KeyboardInterrupt and the tool returns status=timeout with any partial stdout. Defaults to 30000 (30s); set higher for ML training, web scraping, large groupbys. Maximum is 600000 (10 min).
